newsitem.title: USA: Intermagnetics says acquisition to up FY98 results.
newsitem.headline: Intermagnetics says acquisition to up FY98 results.

text.p: Intermagnetics General Corp said Wednesday it expects Medical Advances Inc, which it acquired in March, to provide a more substantial contribution in revenues and earnings in its fiscal year 1998.

Carl Rosner, chairman and chief executive of the company, noted that the acquisition was made late in the fiscal year, which ended on May 25, so its results did not contribute materially to 1997 earnings.

"The acquisition also provides a strong strategic fit, enabling us to focus more on the needs of medical resonance imaging end-users and giving Intermagnetics direct contacts with that important market," he said.

Intermagnetics, which makes superconducting magnets, wire and cable and low-temperature refrigeration equipment, acquired Advance Materials, a supplier of radio frequency coils used for clinical diagnostic MRI for $12 million in cash and stock.
